body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and push it 1 unit if it is Distracted or Slowed.

surges.html: After a hit, yourself or one willing ally within 3 units may move 1 unit into cover.

rider.title: Lock - Execution
rider.html: After a hit, you may end Lock on the target to create concealment in your space until the start of your next turn.
